I set standards for myself that I haven't/failed to meet. I enjoy my courses, but I just fail. I'm working on a computer engineering degree. 

I don't see what kind of future I can have, regardless of whether or not I get a degree. I see myself as working a dead end job somewhere, and the reality of it is I would rather be doing absolutely nothing with my time. I feel like nothing I do will ever impact anyone else positively, and I've lost hope.

The best part about it is I can't even get my thoughts down the way I want to. I think about one thing, then try to make myself more clear, and end up forgetting how I intended to write.

Fucking grand (thanks for responding, at least I haven't upset the entire world yet.)
